The narration is in English with Hebrew quoted UI text. The rewrite should be English, 1-2 short sentences, in my own words, and address the reported "all red numbers are for other funds" idea — that's Claude's own reasoning, not a stray ask. Claude's statement that the top fund is the one to choose is a conclusion; I can keep it briefly.

Pesagot is the first bank at 86,492 and the top fund is the one to pick; I'll move on to the red numbers next.
Screen 4 is in English with fund names I can't read, and screen 5 shows a red figure and a Hebrew label, so I'm checking one more screen before I give up.
Screen 6 showed a four-line chart I didn't read, plus a table listing 105,608 over 12 years and a 21.8% drop in 2022. That drop is what hit me back then, so I'm stopping here.

input.answer: According to the page, I'd open the account at Pesagot and buy the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". With 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for ten years, that would come to about 86,492 ₪. But Pesagot isn't my bank and I don't understand half the words, so I won't do anything before I ask you, my son.
